guardrails: Cooja inference is limited to the current fixed 8-mote embedded implementation.
compact-onehop is a dense radio-layout regime, not claimed to be identical to Python star.
SUCCESS_RATIO_TX is a Cooja radio parameter and is not equated with Python packet_loss.
The pilot was used only as a bootstrap/harness validity gate, not for statistical selection.
No additional confirmatory seeds are added after observing outcomes.
No universal protocol winner is assumed.
multiple_testing: Holm correction across all 24 layout × TX × pair comparisons, separately for reconstruction and completion.
